note: GAUNTLET floor mutators (D-017). `tuning` patches Sim opts.tuning; `balance` patches a host-side clone of balance/core.json. Stacking: one new mutator is revealed per floor from floor 2, and every active mutator applies to BOTH fighters.

mutators.name: Deep Cuts
mutators.desc: Every wound starts lacerated — both fighters open at wound state 2.

mutators.name: Acid Pools
mutators.desc: The blood on the floor has turned. Standing in a pool burns instead of paying.

mutators.name: Thin Blood
mutators.desc: Bleeding drains twice as fast. Tourniquets are suddenly interesting.

mutators.name: The Starved Rift
mutators.desc: Meter gain halved — the Rift keeps more of every drop.

mutators.name: Short Fuse
mutators.desc: 45-second rounds. Say what you came to say.

mutators.name: The Bell Tolls
mutators.desc: One round decides it. No second chances on this floor.
